AUTHOR: Bürgi
TITLE: Automated counting of fish in moving diver-operated videos (DOV) for biodiversity assessments
REGION: Mediterranean Sea, eight locations (2022 campaigns, RECIF/FishHealth projects)
SPECIES: Epinephelus marginatus, Sciaena umbra, Diplodus vulgaris
DATA: Own diver-operated GoPro transect videos (55 videos; 125 m2 transects, 2022); image/annotation data on Dryad
V_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'The depth ranged from 1 to 37 m, and data were collected in 2022 at different times of the year (cold and warm season).'
D2: Video-level train/validation/test allocation (7 videos moved to validation, 5 high-abundance videos moved to test); counts per split not given
D_EV: Sec. 2.2.1: 'We moved seven videos from the training to the validation set ... five videos with the highest occurrence rates were removed from the training and incorporated into the test set.'
R_EV: Sec. 2.1: all videos collected in eight Mediterranean locations in 2022 within the same campaign; test videos are a held-out subset of this collection.
C_EV: Sec 3.2: 'we found the best performing confidence threshold based on the respective f1 score on the validation set... 0.55 for E. marginatus, 0.60 for S. umbra and 0.45 for D. vulgaris.'
E_EV: Sec. 2.2.2: 'A marine biology expert counted the actual fish abundance/count (True FishAbundance) per video'; methods compared via AE, APE and Pearson correlation.
ARCH: Modified YOLOv7 detector + per-video count aggregation (Nmax, 1D k-means NCluster, NHeuristic, Temporal Convolutional Network)
METR: mAP, F1 (detector); absolute error, absolute percentage error, Pearson correlation of counts
NOTE: Detector 'fine-tuned on similar data by Bürgi et al. (2024)' -> PRE coded 수중 데이터셋. E1 '복수': per-video abundance and Nmax compared against expert counts of the same videos (inter-operator CV also reported). Per-species thresholds F1-optimised on validation -> C_ALL=P. School-clustering count aggregation (NCluster/NHeuristic/TCN) addresses multi-frame counting but is not framed as explicit duplicate/ID-switch handling and FP counts in zero-occurrence videos are only described from GT comparison -> C5 coded 없음 (verifier may argue 중복계수 처리, which would make C_ALL=Y). Habitat type not explicitly stated (Mediterranean, various habitats) -> ENV NR.
AUTHORS_FULL: Bürgi, K; Sun, RY; Bouveyron, C; Lingrand, D; Dérijard, B; Precioso, F; Sabourault, C
